Solution B is correct. Solution A has an arithmetic error.

Isolating the absolute value gives $|x-4| = 12$, so $x - 4 = 12$ or $x - 4 = -12$. That yields $x = 16$ or $x = -8$, with product $16 \times (-8) = -128$.

Solution A sets up the second case correctly as $-(x-4) - 10 = 2$, which gives $-(x-4) = 12$, so $x - 4 = -12$ and $x = -8$. It then writes $x - 4 = -8$ instead, producing the wrong value $x = -4$ and the wrong product $-64$.

WINNER: B
